name: @devflowai/cli
stderr:
Usage: devflow [options] [command]

DevFlow AI: evidence-driven AI software engineering workflows.

Options:
  -v, --version                print the DevFlow version
  -h, --help                   show help

Commands:
  task                         work with task files
  trust [options] [directory]  review the workspace configuration and trust it,
                               show its status, or revoke it
  plugins                      manage external language adapter plugins (your
                               own list, never the repository's)
  verify [options]             run the verification gates (tests, lint, type
                               checks) through the command policy
  contracts                    check OpenAPI and Protobuf contracts
  init [options]               write .devflow/config.yaml and a rules template,
                               and ignore .devflow/runs/
  analyze [options]            analyse a task's requirements against the
                               repository (assist mode)
  plan [options]               analyse a task and write an implementation plan
                               for review (assist mode)
  implement [options]          implement a task test-first: tests, red run, code
                               change, green run and repairs (implement mode)
  run [options]                run the full workflow for a task (the same as
                               devflow implement)
  test [options]               write tests for a task's acceptance criteria and
                               run them against the current code (test mode)
  review [options]             review the local change (working tree against a
                               base) for a task: gates, deterministic checks and
                               an AI review (review mode)
  approve [options] <run>      approve the plan, the tests or the code change a
                               run is waiting on
  reject [options] <run>       reject the plan, the tests or the code change
                               with feedback; DevFlow writes it again
  answer [options] <run>       answer clarification questions; the analysis
                               continues once none blocks
  resume [options] <run>       continue an interrupted run; limits, model,
                               provider and command approvals can be given
  agent                        agent mode: the coding agent that runs DevFlow
                               answers its model requests, no API key (ADR 0027)
  cancel [options] <run>       cancel a run that has not finished
  status [options] [run]       list the runs of this workspace, or show one
  report [options] <run>       print the report of a finished run (Markdown, or
                               JSON with --json)
  trace [options] <run>        export the trace of a run (OpenTelemetry
                               OTLP/JSON, metadata only): to a file, or to an
                               OTLP endpoint with --otlp
  mcp [options]                serve the DevFlow tools to an MCP client (a
                               coding agent) over stdio; approvals stay in the
                               terminal
  pr                           work with GitHub pull requests
  help [command]               display help for command
